title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree Summary Judgment And The Text There Is No God But Allah

questions.question: What central belief is declared at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: That only Allah is worthy of worship and that He truly exists as the One and only God.

questions.question: Which human being is presented as a major witness to Allah’s oneness in this passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What title in the passage shows the high honor given to the Prophet among people?
questions.answer: He is described as the pride of the world and the honor of the children of Adam.

questions.question: What four qualities of the Prophet are mentioned as signs supporting his truthfulness?
questions.answer: The greatness of the Qur’an given to him, the wide reach of his religion, his many excellent qualities, and his noble character.

questions.question: How does the passage show that even opponents recognized something special about the Prophet?
questions.answer: It says that even his enemies confirmed his outstanding qualities.

questions.question: Besides his character, what other strong proof is mentioned from the Prophet’s life?
questions.answer: His many clear miracles.

questions.question: What is said about the truths found in his religion?
questions.answer: They are many, bright, and decisive proofs.

questions.question: Which three groups agree in supporting the truth of his message?
questions.answer: His blessed family, his companions, and the scholars of his community.

questions.question: What kind of people are the scholars of his community described as being?
questions.answer: People of proof and clear spiritual insight.

questions.question: In this passage, what truth about Allah is being supported?
questions.answer: Allah’s necessary existence and His absolute oneness.

questions.question: Through whom is that truth especially indicated?
questions.answer: Through Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an connected to the Prophet?
questions.answer: It speaks of the greatness and powerful reach of the Qur’an that came with him.

questions.question: How does the spread of the Prophet’s religion function as evidence in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows the strength and impact of his mission.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s personal qualities?
questions.answer: It presents him as having many excellences and very elevated manners.

questions.question: Whose testimony is especially surprising because it supports the Prophet despite opposition?
questions.answer: The testimony of his enemies.

questions.question: Are the miracles mentioned as hidden and doubtful or clear and strong?
questions.answer: They are presented as clear, shining, and powerful.

questions.question: What do the truths in the religion do besides simply exist?
questions.answer: They support and confirm the message with strong evidence.

questions.question: What statement of faith opens the passage in meaning?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: How is Allah described to show that His existence does not depend on anything else?
questions.answer: As the One whose existence is necessary.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: That He is one without any partner and unique.

questions.question: Who points people to this truth of divine unity according to the passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet given such a high rank in the passage?
questions.answer: Because he strongly proves and testifies to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What part of the Prophet’s message is described as majestic and far-reaching?
questions.answer: The Qur’an and the religion brought through him.

questions.question: What personal side of the Prophet is used as evidence besides miracles?
questions.answer: His excellent character and many perfections.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the miracles connected to the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: As numerous, open, and convincing signs of truth.

questions.question: What role do the companions play in this passage?
questions.answer: Their united agreement supports the truth of his message.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the long Arabic passage and its translation?
questions.answer: A declaration of Allah’s oneness and the strong proofs supporting it.

questions.question: Which messenger is shown as the leading human proof in this declaration?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the relationship between the Prophet and the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The greatness of the Qur’an is one of the signs supporting the truth of the Prophet.

questions.question: How does the size or reach of the Prophet’s religion help the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that his message had great power and influence.

questions.question: What moral evidence from the Prophet’s life is mentioned?
questions.answer: His high character and many noble qualities.

questions.question: Why is mention of enemy testimony important?
questions.answer: Because praise from opponents is harder to dismiss and makes the evidence stronger.

questions.question: How are the companions described in a positive spiritual way?
questions.answer: As enlightened people who support the truth.

questions.question: What belief about Allah is the passage trying to strengthen in the reader?
questions.answer: Faith that Allah truly exists and is completely one.

questions.question: Who is the human witness emphasized most in proving that belief?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s Qur’an as a source of evidence?
questions.answer: Its greatness and authority support the truth of his mission.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the religion brought by the Prophet?
questions.answer: It is broad in reach and contains many bright and certain truths.

questions.question: Which inner qualities of the Prophet support his truthfulness?
questions.answer: His many excellences and his lofty character.

questions.question: What kind of proof do miracles provide in this passage?
questions.answer: They provide strong, visible evidence that confirms his message.

questions.question: Which group shows support through close companionship with the Prophet?
questions.answer: His companions.

questions.question: Which group shows support through study, proof, and insight?
questions.answer: The scholars of his community.

questions.question: What is the shortest way to state the main message of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah is one, and the Prophet strongly points people to that truth.

questions.question: Which description of Allah appears in the passage to show complete uniqueness?
questions.answer: That He is the One and the Unique.

questions.question: Which honored person is described as a means by which people recognize this truth?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What public sign of the Prophet’s mission is mentioned first among his supporting qualities?
questions.answer: The greatness and authority of the Qur’an connected with him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the religion he brought?
questions.answer: It spread widely and contains many clear truths.

questions.question: What private or personal evidence is mentioned from the Prophet himself?
questions.answer: His many perfections and his elevated character.

questions.question: Why does the passage include the view of the Prophet’s enemies?
questions.answer: To show that his greatness was recognized even by those against him.

questions.question: What two large categories of proof from the Prophet are named directly?
questions.answer: His miracles and the truths found in his religion.

questions.question: What three circles of supporters are named as agreeing with his witness?
questions.answer: His family, his companions, and the scholars of his ummah.
